title: Expected cost of a retry policy
prompt_text: An API call fails independently with probability 0.2 on each attempt. Every attempt costs 1 unit. The policy allows up to 3 attempts; if all 3 fail, a penalty of 10 units is paid and the call is abandoned. What is the expected total cost per call? Then: would raising the limit to 4 attempts lower the expected cost, and by how much? Show the arithmetic.

An API call fails independently with probability 0.2 on each attempt. Every attempt costs 1 unit. The policy allows up to 3 attempts; if all 3 fail, a penalty of 10 units is paid and the call is abandoned. What is the expected total cost per call? Then: would raising the limit to 4 attempts lower the expected cost, and by how much? Show the arithmetic.

content:
Let the cost be:

- Each attempt costs 1 unit.
- A penalty of 10 units is paid if all 3 attempts fail.

On each attempt, failure probability is 0.2, success probability is 0.8.

Expected cost per call:

\[
E = P(\text{fail all 3}) \cdot (3\cdot1 + 10) + P(\text{not all 3 fail}) \cdot (1 + \text{expected remaining attempts})
\]

More directly, expected cost = expected number of attempts + probability of penalty × 10.

\[
P(\text{fail all 3}) = 0.2^3 = 0.008
\]

Expected number of attempts:

\[
E[\text{attempts}] = 1\cdot P(\text{success on 1st}) + 2\cdot P(\text{fail 1st, success 2nd}) + 3\cdot P(\text{fail first two, success 3rd}) + 3\cdot P(\text{fail all 3})
\]

\[
= 1(0.8) + 2(0.2\cdot 0.8) + 3(0.2^2 \cdot 0.8) + 3(0.2^3)
\]

\[
= 0.8 + 0.32 + 0.096 + 0.024 = 1.336
\]

Expected penalty:

\[
0.008 \cdot 10 = 0.08
\]

Total expected cost:

\[
E = 1.336 + 0.08 = 1.416
\]

So expected cost per call is 1.416 units.

Now, with 4 attempts:

\[
P(\text{fail all 4}) = 0.2^4 = 0.0016
\]

Expected attempts:

\[
E[\text{attempts}] = 1(0.8) + 2(0.16) + 3(0.032) + 4(0.008) + 4(0.0016)
\]

\[
= 0.8 + 0.32 + 0.096 + 0.032 + 0.0064 = 1.2544
\]

Expected penalty:

\[
0.0016 \cdot 10 = 0.016
\]

Total expected cost:

\[
E_4 = 1.2544 + 0.016 = 1.2704
\]

Difference:

\[
E_4 - E_3 = 1.2704 - 1.416 = -0.1456
\]

So yes, raising the limit to 4 attempts lowers the expected cost by 0.1456 units.
